reviews.title: Perfect app
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app to track my calories for over 3 years and it’s been a complete blessing, it makes tracking calories simple. The user interface is intuitive, easy to understand, and is updated regularly to fine tune or add new features. 10/10

reviews.title: Game Changer

reviews.title: Visual clarity
reviews.text: Easy to use and I love the visual representation of progress toward my daily target. It’s motivating and has kept me on track for 2 weeks so far. It’s customizable either way several different options on what info is displayed, colors, including macro tracking or not, etc.

reviews.title: Great app without junk services
reviews.text: I really like how clean and simple this can be compared to others. Plus the Dev keeps updating it regularly which makes it even better. It needs a “suggestion box” because there are a few shortcomings could make food entry quicker and easier. Otherwise, solid app and I will continue to use it!

reviews.title: Great App

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I was excited to use this app because I read it had a one-time lifetime purchase of around $40, and I hate subscription models. Unfortunately, the one-time option has been removed and the only way to use this app is to pay around $40 *monthly* to access all the features. Uninstalled and unsubscribed immediately.

reviews.title: WTF

This used to be the best app for tracking.  Now, with the AI update it sucks.  Whenever you try to log something using grams it uses that amount for the serving size.  AND, there is no way to go back to the non-AI app.

reviews.title: Calory App Helps See Progress
reviews.text:
Great app overall. Scan food, barcodes is amazing.
Need to be able to retroactively enter start weight. Maybe there’s a way but I couldn’t see it. I wrote the UX team. Will update if I get a response. Cheers.

Since July 2 2026 I’ve lost 10 lb. It’s Aug 19. Success.

I must have been eating like a cow🤦‍♀️

reviews.title: The easiest calorie tracker!

reviews.title: Offline Could be better
reviews.text: This is a great app that I found for counting calories. The one I usually use needs internet just to log anything except water. Offline could definitely be better, when I try to find meals a lot of them don’t show up so I just go off the ingredients that I know are in the food which still helps. It’s just that for the meals or snacks that I know I needed internet to find, it doesn’t let me edit it on a new day except for the serving I did when I had internet. That’s a few gripes I have about this app. It’s a good one for if you don’t have service for a long while.

reviews.title: Lost 18 lbs since 3/28/26
reviews.text: I started using this app 3/28/26. I was struggling to lose weight. It all comes down to calculations. Working out is important but this app and eating in a healthy deficit with realistic goals has been the only thing to truly work. It’s 6/25/26 right now & I am 5 lbs away from the goal I set in the app.

reviews.title: Great for general logging!
reviews.text:
This app is great for general logging! I love the simple layout of filling the circle visuals. Search as quick and simple.

However, the AI and speech to text options, lack accuracy, causing you to double check measurements and food sources. Wish it was more accurate from that standpoint.

reviews.title: Love it BUTT
reviews.text: Every time my weight goes down, the app doesn't update properly to show that I've lost weight. For example, if it previously said "40 lbs gained" and my weight drops, it just changes to "31.7 lbs gained." It would make a lot more sense and be much more motivating if the app accurately switched to showing how much weight was actually lost instead of always framing it as "gained." Please fix this tracking logic it’s so discouraging because you don’t see progress if the app still sees it as something that needs to be lost !

reviews.title: Don’t buy premium
reviews.text:
Good app but don’t buy premium for two very simple and large reasons:

1. The app constantly forgets you have premium and makes you restore your purchase now, creating a ton of friction.  This essentially never happened before and now it’s several times a week.

2. You can’t even automatically log a specific thing every day without premium PLUS, whatever that is.  This feature requires no server costs and no continued development.

The more well known apps are less annoying about their subscriptions.  Can’t believe I have to restore my purchases constantly, then get upsold for another subscription.  Consider one of those.

reviews.title: Very good but
reviews.text: I really like this app. It’s almost perfect but has a few snags.  First, recipes are not integrated into logging food.  They give you the serving data but doesn’t seem possible to log a single serving.  Second, scanning is not always linked correctly. The option will sometimes be wrong as it doesn’t include nutrition scan in the food selection page but defaults to it if it was the last one used.  Third, add favorites is a bit mysterious.

reviews.title: AI function is not great
reviews.text: I brought a higher level to test out the AI, and the model doesn’t recognized any common asian veggie and dishes. You are better off to use other AIs to break it down for you, but user interface is still very nice! I do hope you can improve the barcode scanning options. It was keep crashing out, and it can pull in the wrong item? The search button can be buggy. I mainly stayed because of overall UI, but food database and AI tools are lacking compared to other apps.

reviews.title: Great app, if a bit buggy
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for more than a year and there’s a lot I like about it. The Apple Watch app, widgets, counting of burned calories, and it’s simpler design than all the competitors who plaster their services with ads about fitness and the latest fad diets. However the delay between opening the app and the calories burned syncing is very annoying, and this also only happens on the phone app and not the watch app, so I end up using it less because I know the calorie count will be off until I open the phone app and wait 10+ seconds. The iPad app is also borderline unusable with UI views that are just broken.

reviews.title: Lifetime Subscriber…👍🏾

And the barcode scanning isn’t working. It’s just force quitting on me every time I use it. It’s not convenient if I have to manually input every item when it recognizes the item, but the facts aren’t matching.
